final: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, SUM(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), average_rate AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM media_rates) SELECT m.Name, m.rate, m.track_count, m.rate - a.rate AS above_average FROM media_rates AS m CROSS JOIN average_rate AS a WHERE m.rate > a.rate
